requirements.name: Revenue close ownership
requirements.source: - Own the revenue close each month: journal entries, accruals for returns and wholesale allowances, and account reconciliations.

requirements.name: ASC 606 application
requirements.source: - Apply ASC 606 to new contract types and sales programs, and document the accounting conclusions.

requirements.name: E-commerce and POS reconciliation
requirements.source: - Reconcile e-commerce, point-of-sale and payment processor data to the general ledger.

requirements.name: Revenue flux analysis
requirements.source: - Prepare revenue flux analyses and explain variances to the Controller and FP&A.

requirements.name: SOX internal controls
requirements.source: - Maintain and test internal controls over revenue in support of our SOX readiness work.

requirements.name: Audit support
requirements.source: - Prepare schedules and support for the annual external audit.

requirements.name: NetSuite process improvement
requirements.source: - Improve close processes and reporting in NetSuite.

requirements.source: - Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance.

requirements.name: CPA license or in progress
requirements.source: - CPA license, or actively working toward it.

requirements.name: 4+ years accounting experience
requirements.source: - 4+ years of accounting experience, including revenue accounting; public accounting experience is a plus.

requirements.source: - 4+ years of accounting experience, including revenue accounting; public accounting experience is a plus.
